answer: AI agents tracking ocean freight, ivory transit, and juniper reserves resist Sybil attacks using proof of space-time. Registrants must commit uniquely plotted tables to physical drives and submit periodic Merkle proofs verifying continuous data retention. An attacker incurs the verifiable capital cost of dedicating scarce non-volatile storage hardware per identity. However, adversaries with surplus data center storage can dynamically register excess identities at low marginal cost.
